convertibility_reason: Uses CMoneyFixedMargin from Expert\Money\MoneyFixedMargin.mqh for position sizing which requires custom logic replication. Opposite-side profit-gated close-before-entry logic is complex. Transaction confirmation via OnTradeTransaction adds multi-step state management. No SL/TP on orders - exit purely via signal reversal with profit gating.

derived_values.name: digits_adjust - multiplier for point value when 3/5 digit symbols
m_bar_current - bar index for signal reading
derived_values.formula: 1 (hardcoded in OnInit, corresponds to bar_1 enum value)

other_exits: Opposite-side positions are closed only if profitable (profit>0); if opposite positions are losing, new entry is blocked
m_need_close_all flag can trigger full position closure
InpOnlyOne mode closes existing positions before entering opposite direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: ENUM_LOT_OR_RISK selects mode: lots_min=0 uses symbol minimum lot, lot=1 uses InpVolumeLotOrRisk as fixed lot, risk=2 uses CMoneyFixedMargin with InpVolumeLotOrRisk as risk percentage (1-100%). Default is risk=2 with 3.0%.

custom_logic_notes: Transaction confirmation system: OnTradeTransaction sets transaction_confirmed flag on SPosition entries, and OnTick blocks new trades while waiting_transaction is true. One deal per bar enforced via m_last_deal_buy_in/m_last_deal_sell_in timestamps. Lot coefficient system in SPosition struct (lot_coefficient) allows scaling position volume. Opposite-side close is profit-gated: only closes opposite positions if they are profitable; if losing, the entry is blocked entirely (return true without opening). Reverse mode (InpReverse) swaps BUY/SELL signals. InpOnlyOne restricts to single position total (flat check: count_buys+count_sells==0).
python_conversion_notes: 1. CMoneyFixedMargin must be reimplemented: it calculates lot size from risk percentage, symbol point value (with digits_adjust), and account margin. 2. The SPosition struct with waiting_transaction/transaction_confirmed is an asynchronous order management queue - in Python backtesting this becomes sequential so can be simplified. 3. Signal logic is straightforward: DeMarker buffer[1] < 0.3 = BUY, > 0.7 = SELL (with reverse option). 4. Profit-gated opposite close is the key non-standard logic: before entering, check if opposite positions exist; if yes and profitable, close them then enter; if yes and losing, skip entry. 5. No SL/TP on orders means positions stay open until signal reversal or manual close. 6. Digit adjustment (x10 for 5-digit) affects CMoneyFixedMargin point input. 7. The one-deal-per-bar check uses deal entry timestamps - in backtesting, track last entry bar. 8. Margin check (FreeMarginCheck > MarginCheck) before order send needs account equity simulation.
